notes.title: Update 1.0.59.3667
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/1d884a1cfdb1c8c263a1fcdfb0970d2469130f37.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Errors related to the addition of the new "Armor" category have been fixed. Bonuses to rocket characteristics have been added for the Old Tank Base. Minor balance adjustments have been made.[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]A bug that prevented viewing items from the "Armor" category in the base production menu and, consequently, their production has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug that caused the display of characteristics for items from the "Armor" category to be turned off has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]An icon for items from the "Armor" category has been added to the item card and repair menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The category for some turret bases has been corrected; they are now correctly filtered by the "Structures" category and repaired according to the set repair priority for this category.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes in Turret Base Characteristics[/h3][p]Old Tank Base[/p][list][*][p]Level has been increased from 3 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Energy consumption has been increased from 1 to 24.[/p][/*][*][p]Mass has been increased from 1700 to 2400.[/p][/*][*][p]Durability has been increased from 2400 to 18000.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bonuses to weapons installed on the base have been reworked.[/p][list][*][p]The base enhances cannons: +40% damage, vertical aiming angles +250%, turn speed +70%.[/p][/*][*][p]The base enhances rocket launchers: +30% damage, rocket flight speed +30%, rocket maneuverability +25%.[/p][/*][/list][p]Helicopter Scrap Base[/p][list][*][p]Level has been increased from 3 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Durability has been increased from 3000 to 9000.[/p][/*][/list][p]Abrams turret base:[/p][list][*][p]Bonus to explosive damage for grenade launchers has been reduced from 150% to 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus to explosion radius for grenade launchers has been reduced from 5 to 4 meters.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes in Weapons[/h3][p]“Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher”[/p][list][*][p]Base explosive damage has been increased from 3960 to 4800.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosion radius has been increased from 13 to 14 meters.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: The enhancement of the launcher is aimed at compensating for the weakening of bonuses to grenade launchers from the Abrams turret base, as the smoke launcher cannot be considered a standalone weapon type capable of inflicting significant damage without this base.[/p][h3]Cannons[/h3][p]Reload time has been reduced:[/p][p]Cannon VI PP 100 mm by 15%.[/p][p]Cannon V PP 90 mm by 25%.[/p][p]Cannon IV PP 75 mm by 30%.[/p][p]Cannon III PP 60 mm by 35%.[/p][p]Cannon II PP 50 mm by 40%.[/p][p]Cannon I PP 45 mm by 45%.[/p][p]Comment: Statistics show low effectiveness of this weapon type, especially at low levels when crew reload perks are not yet leveled up. We hope that this enhancement, combined with the ability to get a 40% damage boost from the Old Tank Base, will help achieve the required effectiveness.[/p][p]Grenade Launchers:[/p][list][*][p]Bonus to explosive damage from structures has been reduced from 20% to 10%.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Statistics show an extremely high effectiveness of grenade launchers specifically in combination with installed turret bases, so we decided not to directly reduce the characteristics of grenade launchers, but only to weaken the damage bonus from structures.[/p][p]Flamethrowers:[/p][list][*][p]Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 110.[/p][/*][*][p]Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 150 to 160.[/p][/*][/list][p]Minigun:[/p][list][*][p]Base durability has been increased from 180,000 to 270,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Base turn speed has been increased from 10 to 15 deg/sec.[/p][/*][/list][p]The characteristics of weapons now display the "Projectile velocity" parameter, and rocket characteristics display "Missile maneuverability".[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.58.3665
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/b55c1a39328f3078b2dfe2987a2a9848d16f9c46.png"][/img][/p][p]Atman confrontation quest fixes and minor balance adjustments.[/p][h3]Fixes in the Atman confrontation quest chain:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when moving certain quest items from the Atmans confrontation chain to the base warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where quest items for the Atman confrontation quest chain dropped even without the corresponding quests has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest items from the Atman confrontation quest chain can now be thrown overboard, which will allow getting rid of items that were obtained due to an error.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where it was impossible to get the "Spare Parts" quest from NPC Ashley on the aircraft carrier  to obtain Atman Weapon Fragments has been fixed. This repeatable quest is now correctly issued.[/p][/*][*][p]A quest objective marker has been added in the aircraft carrier quest to destroy the Atman flagship.[/p][/*][*][p]The reward for repeatable Atman quests has been increased from 5000 to 15000 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]The chance of medallions dropping from Atman ships no longer depends on the presence of active quests for obtaining their items for repeatable quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Text and localization fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Increased power gain from funnels, air intakes, and fan motors:[/h3][list][*][p]Power gain from "Huge Funnel" Level 5 has been increased from 300,000 to 420,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Midsize Funnel" Level 4 has been increased from 120,000 to 170,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Warship Air Intake" Level 5 has been increased from 72,000 to 104,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Steamship Air Intake" Level 4 has been increased from 26,000 to 36,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Base power of Fan Motors of Rank 3-5 has been increased by 33%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes in weapon characteristics:[/h3][list][*][p]Machine Gun Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 10 to 16.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade Launcher Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 30 to 60.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Grenade Launchers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bonus to explosion radius from structures has been reduced from 2 to 1 meter (except for Three-Story Cabin and Abrams turret base).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shotguns:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 120 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet damage falloff with distance has been reduced by 20% (effective range increased).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Flamethrowers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Maximum range has been increased from 80 to 100 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 120 to 150.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Minor adjustments to grenade launchers and machine guns were planned to be implemented  in the update 1.0.52.3655, but were postponed to collect more statistics and analyze them. These two weapon types show higher than expected effectiveness, but due to their high popularity among players, we decided not to directly reduce their damage, but to limit it over a long firing interval by increasing energy consumption per shot. At the same time, shotguns and flamethrowers, despite their high damage, are unable to realize it due to the need for close combat with the enemy. We hope that increasing the effective attack range will allow these weapon types to find more fans.[/p][p][b]"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"[/b][/p][list][*][p]Energy consumption reduced from 210 to 140.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Although this installation is not a full-fledged weapon type, we hope that such a reduction in energy consumption will allow it to be combined with shotguns and flamethrowers for safe approach to enemies in PvP events.[/p][p][b]Dreadripper[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun durability has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun damage has been increased by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]To sink Dreadripper, it is now necessary to blow up 5 fuel tanks instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Erroneous display of the boss marker in separate locations intended for battles with other bosses has been disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Display of the boss marker for players on ships below Rank 4 has been disabled.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Hull Material Changes[/h3][p][b]Plastic Sheathing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Speed bonus has been increased from 20% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Ship mass reduction bonus has been improved from -30% to -40%.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Wood Sheathing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resistance to burning damage disabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Metal Sheathing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hull mass penalty has been reduced from 15% to 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Segment durability bonus has been increased from 150% to 180%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other changes and fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Side armor and other protective structures have been moved to a separate inventory category, and their repair priority can now be configured separately.[/p][/*][*][p]The intensity of passive water ingress through a breached segment has been increased for Rank 4 and 5 hulls, by 1.5 and 2 times respectively.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: This change specifically affects passive (slow) flooding of the hull when side segments are destroyed. The goal is to reduce situations where high rank ships, equipped with a large number of pumps, could remain nearly invincible even when more than half of their segments were destroyed.[/p][list][*][p]Text chat pop-up messages are now separated from notifications about receiving and sorting items and other notifications. An option to disable chat messages has been added to the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]High-level dredges now consume significantly more energy to start the mining process.[/p][/*][*][p]For most rank 1 and 2 ships, base energy production has been increased by 10 units.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual effects of hits and module damage have been  improved, and missing ones have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Acidic algae, which caused damage over time to the main ship in the PvP event "Attack on Caravan", have been removed from its path.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.52.3655
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/5afa5b6b2bdd3d8f60c8186c42467762b5c9d521.jpg"][/img]A new quest line, new weapons - 3 flamethrowers of different rarity, reduced fleet respawn time and text chat bug fixes await you in our new update.[/p][p]Added a new quest line where you have to fight the Atman fleets and disrupt their plans. Start it by talking to the mayor in Three Whales! Note: Dialogue texts in new quests may contain errors and inaccuracies, and voice acting is absent, we plan to fix this in the future.[/p][p]Added three flamethrowers of different rarity[/p][p]From the loot of Atman's Rank 5 ships ("Grasp", "ST Octa", "Glare" and "Midori"), which appear in some fleets on the last wave:[/p][list][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1% chance.[/p][/*][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 0.5% chance.[/p][/*][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.1% chance.[/p][/*][/list][p]From Dreadripper's loot:[/p][list][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1.5% chance.[/p][/*][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 1% chance.[/p][/*][*][p]"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.3% chance.[/p][/*][/list][p]Pirate Flotillas[/p][list][*][p]Respawn time interval has been reduced from 60-360 seconds to 60-75 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Atman Flotillas[/p][list][*][p]Respawn time interval has been reduced from 150-450 seconds to 75-90 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience gained for sinking ships from the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased from 750 to 1500.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of medallions obtained from opponents of the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased by 2 times.[/p][/*][/list][p]Text chat bug fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed several general text chat channel errors that caused message delivery and reception failures after grouping up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that caused text chat to disconnect when voice chat was disconnected.[/p][/*][*][p]Text message delivery is no longer limited by distance between players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the nickname of the sender of a private message to be displayed as "Unknown".[/p][/*][/list][p]Dreadripper[/p][list][*][p]Minimum spawn distance to the nearest player has been increased from 500 to 1500 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss marker display distance has been increased from 3000 to 8000 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss respawn time has been reduced from 40 to 30 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed power consumption issue that caused four artillery guns located inside the hull to shut down.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 650,000 to 1,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Miniguns have been moved from the bow platform to the side cranes.[/p][/*][*][p]A second four-barreled gun has been added to the bow platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Dead zones have been added to each weapon, for example, the rocket launcher will no longer attack at distances less than 250 meters, and all weapons have limited aiming angles.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Dreadripper has become stronger in situations where you are far from it, and it is able to fire from all weapons, but at the same time, situations where it can fire through its own hull are almost completely excluded. Thus, by getting closer to it, you can find safe places, which will become more numerous as Dreadripper's weapons are destroyed.[/p][p]Boss behind the "Hunt for the 'Scuttlefish' (Group)" teleport[/p][list][*][p]All weapon damage has been reduced by 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Detonation of each of the three generators now reduces the boss's total durability by 9% instead of 5%.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience gained for destruction has been reduced from 9000 to 7000.[/p][/*][*][p]Time interval blocking loot drop in case of too fast repeated boss destruction has been reduced from 60 to 40 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]PvP mission "Attack on Caravan"[/p][list][*][p]Durability of the main ship and escort ships has been increased by 8 and 20 times respectively.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward for sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward for assisting in sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward gained per 1 second of caravan escort for defenders has been increased from 50 to 100 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.[/p][/*][/list][p]PvP mission "Treasure Hunt"[/p][list][*][p]The condition for starting missions in the northeast and southeast has been simplified. Now they should start more often.[/p][/*][*][p]Capture point time in all locations has been increased to 180 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.[/p][/*][/list][p]Machine Guns[/p][list][*][p]Overheating mechanic has been disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]For machine guns of levels 1-4, magazine size has been reduced to 125.[/p][/*][*][p]Machine gun spread now decreases with weapon level, improving accuracy. Machine guns of levels 1–4 had their spread increase per shot raised by 20–40%, while levels 5 and 6 had it lowered by 15% and 50% respectively.[/p][/*][/list][p]Shotguns[/p][list][*][p]Shotgun damage has been increased by 40%.[/p][/*][/list][p]"Dreadripper Minigun"[/p][list][*][p]Base mass has been reduced from 150,000 to 120,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum and minimum spread has been reduced by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum projectile flight distance has been increased from 600 to 700 meters.[/p][/*][/list][p]"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"[/p][list][*][p]Energy consumption per shot has been reduced from 5000 to 3000.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosion radius has been increased from 11 to 13 meters.[/p][/*][/list][p]Other improvements and fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Turning radius of the ST Octa Seiner has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Please note that due to the relatively low mass of the ship itself, its small width, and high speed, with a large number of heavy modules on deck, the ship may experience stability problems during sharp turns. It was impossible to improve the turning radius without these problems due to the peculiarities of the game physics engine, which strives to realistically model the behavior of ships of different hull shapes and displacements.[/p][list][*][p]Durability of outboard motors of levels 2-5 has been increased by 2-2.5 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Cost of Smith's Neutralizer consumable, which allows resetting skills, has been reduced from 250,000 to 150,000 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]To improve comfort at the start of the game, the structure of the initial quest chain has been improved, some starting locations have been moved closer to the Three Whales, and water flows have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fibers and ropes have been removed from drag repair recipes, and instrument parts from the "Looter Drone" recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Base quest names are now highlighted in a different color.[/p][/*][*][p]Chance to get loot for assist has been increased from 25% to 33%.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Chasm location, gates now open from both sides.[/p][/*][*][p]Stack size of temporary boosters has been increased from 500 to 10,000 (already existing boosters will be combined after leaving the base).[/p][/*][*][p]Amount of mining loot in large zones has been reduced from 14 to 7, their respawn time has also been reduced by 2 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Radioisotope generator disassembly recipe has been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements have been made to the anchor and compass interface, also hints about keys that call certain menus have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus from structures to shotgun firing range now correctly updates when moving the shotgun.[/p][/*][*][p]Buoys marking the boundary of the game world are now arranged in a circle, and exiting this boundary leads to teleportation to the Three Whales (in some cases this can be used instead of a translocator)[/p][/*][*][p]The location of the "Trader 12" island has been slightly changed so that after teleportation you can freely sail north.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your feedback and reports. We’ve released a small update 1.0.55.3660 where we’ve fixed a few errors:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]The rewards from the 'Abrams turret base' have been fixed. Players who had completed the relevant quests have now received their rewards. The old rewards have been rendered unusable and can now be salvaged for resources.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Flamethrower rewards in quests have been fixed (we’re still working on a solution for the players who have completed the corresponding quests but didn't receive flamethrowers).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Several bugs in repeatable quests of the new quest chain have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

Text message delivery is no longer limited by distance between players.
Fixed a bug that caused the nickname of the sender of a private message to be displayed as "Unknown".

tags.balance_change: Minimum spawn distance to the nearest player has been increased from 500 to 1500 meters.
Boss marker display distance has been increased from 3000 to 8000 meters.
Boss respawn time has been reduced from 40 to 30 minutes.

tags.bug: Fixed power consumption issue that caused four artillery guns located inside the hull to shut down.

tags.balance_change: Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 650,000 to 1,000,000.

tags.feature: Miniguns have been moved from the bow platform to the side cranes.
A second four-barreled gun has been added to the bow platform.

tags.balance_change: Dead zones have been added to each weapon, for example, the rocket launcher will no longer attack at distances less than 250 meters, and all weapons have limited aiming angles.
All weapon damage has been reduced by 25%.
Detonation of each of the three generators now reduces the boss's total durability by 9% instead of 5%.
Experience gained for destruction has been reduced from 9000 to 7000.
Time interval blocking loot drop in case of too fast repeated boss destruction has been reduced from 60 to 40 seconds.
Durability of the main ship and escort ships has been increased by 8 and 20 times respectively.
Reward for sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.
Reward for assisting in sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.
Reward gained per 1 second of caravan escort for defenders has been increased from 50 to 100 medallions.
Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.

tags.feature: The condition for starting missions in the northeast and southeast has been simplified. Now they should start more often.

tags.balance_change: Capture point time in all locations has been increased to 180 seconds.
Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.
Overheating mechanic has been disabled.
For machine guns of levels 1-4, magazine size has been reduced to 125.

Machine gun spread now decreases with weapon level, improving accuracy. Machine guns of levels 1–4 had their spread increase per shot raised by 20–40%, while levels 5 and 6 had it lowered by 15% and 50% respectively.
Shotgun damage has been increased by 40%.
Base mass has been reduced from 150,000 to 120,000.
Maximum and minimum spread has been reduced by 20%.
Maximum projectile flight distance has been increased from 600 to 700 meters.
Energy consumption per shot has been reduced from 5000 to 3000.
Explosion radius has been increased from 11 to 13 meters.

tags.feature: Turning radius of the ST Octa Seiner has been improved.

tags.balance_change: Durability of outboard motors of levels 2-5 has been increased by 2-2.5 times.
Cost of Smith's Neutralizer consumable, which allows resetting skills, has been reduced from 250,000 to 150,000 medallions.

tags.feature: To improve comfort at the start of the game, the structure of the initial quest chain has been improved, some starting locations have been moved closer to the Three Whales, and water flows have been added.
Fibers and ropes have been removed from drag repair recipes, and instrument parts from the "Looter Drone" recipe.
Base quest names are now highlighted in a different color.

tags.balance_change: Chance to get loot for assist has been increased from 25% to 33%.

tags.feature: In the Chasm location, gates now open from both sides.

tags.balance_change: Stack size of temporary boosters has been increased from 500 to 10,000 (already existing boosters will be combined after leaving the base).
Amount of mining loot in large zones has been reduced from 14 to 7, their respawn time has also been reduced by 2 times.

tags.bug: Radioisotope generator disassembly recipe has been corrected.

tags.feature: Improvements have been made to the anchor and compass interface, also hints about keys that call certain menus have been added.

tags.bug: Bonus from structures to shotgun firing range now correctly updates when moving the shotgun.

tags.feature: Buoys marking the boundary of the game world are now arranged in a circle, and exiting this boundary leads to teleportation to the Three Whales (in some cases this can be used instead of a translocator)
The location of the "Trader 12" island has been slightly changed so that after teleportation you can freely sail north.

tags.bug: The rewards from the 'Abrams turret base' have been fixed. Players who had completed the relevant quests have now received their rewards. The old rewards have been rendered unusable and can now be salvaged for resources.
Flamethrower rewards in quests have been fixed (we’re still working on a solution for the players who have completed the corresponding quests but didn't receive flamethrowers).
Several bugs in repeatable quests of the new quest chain have been fixed.

notes.title: Wind Energy and New Horizons: Q&A about the Storm Tuning Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/80556e764ce5ff059b49047d8ee9e73f9587323a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear friends! We’ve released an update for Age of Water: new ships and weapons have been added, the new energy system is ready to challenge your construction skills, and PvP rewards have been significantly increased.[/p][p]In this post, we’ll answer the most frequent questions about the balance changes, energy, and weapons. Thank you for your support and feedback: it helps us make the game better![/p][h3][b]Q: What are the main goals and objectives of this update?[/b][/h3][p]A: Our primary aim is to breathe new life into Age of Water and make balancing between speed, firepower, and survivability more challenging and fun. We’ve increased the variety of ships and weapons, rebalanced energy consumption and rewards, and ensured that every choice in the shipbuilder carries weight and encourages fresh tactics.[/p][h3][b]Q: How do I rebuild my top-tier ship in light of the new changes?[/b][/h3][p]A: Now there isn’t enough energy to power everything you want, so plan carefully! We recommend first removing any extra Fan Motor modules and adding structures that boost energy production. For example, the "Torpedo Boat Midori Cabin" and the "Rook Boat Cabin A" now provide huge energy bonuses, but, as with many other cabins, they’ve been moved into a new "wheelhouse" category, of which you may set up only one per ship. However, there are other cabins and modules that grant energy boosts without that restriction (see the in-game descriptions), such as the "Three-Story Cabin”," "Rook Boat Cabin B," "Rook Boat Cabin C," and the "Halibut Conning Tower." Think through module placement and their energy demands, and balance your ship’s armament, speed, hull durability, and free cargo space to fit the new meta.[/p][h3][b]Q: How can I achieve sufficient energy after the update if I lack resources to craft generators and modules that give them bonuses?[/b][/h3][p]A: The quickest and most cost-effective route is to craft wind generators at your base. They’ll cover basic needs and simple builds.[/p][h3][b]Q: Does it still make sense to craft an expensive Rank 5 radioisotope generator if a cheaper Rank-5 wind generator produces more energy?[/b][/h3][p]A: Wind generators can look more efficient at first glance, but note that they only receive durability bonuses from modules—not energy production bonuses—and each installed wind generator increases the overall energy output penalty for all wind generators.[/p][h3][b]Q: Why did you make such radical changes to familiar gameplay elements?[/b][/h3][p]A: We overhauled the core balance for the long-term health of the game, aiming to add depth and variety to ship and weapon choices. Before the patch, the dominant build was obvious—Midori, cisterns, cannons—leaving little room for alternatives. Now there are many viable builds, making it much harder to declare any single setup "the best."[/p][h3][b]Q: Won’t these updates devalue old content and the time players invested? And why were cannons changed so drastically?[/b][/h3][p]A: We don’t believe old items are devalued. On top-tier builds, standard generators remain the best choice. While weapon balance has shifted—many older weapons have actually become more effective—cannons and rockets, if anything, lost efficiency through higher energy costs rather than reduced damage. Cannons were too universally strong—about 75% of players used only them—so we increased their energy consumption to open the field to other weapon types. Their raw damage remains the same, but in the new energy scarcity meta they no longer feel as dominant. Energy efficiency and build strategy now matter as much as sheer damage output.[/p][p]We understand this may be uncomfortable for the players who were used to their ship builds. But we hope that new opportunities and challenges will introduce you to different weapon setups while we continue keeping an eye out on the weapon balance.[/p][h3][b]Q: How has the maximum speed of ships changed after the rebalance?[/b][/h3][p]A: Gone are the days of 200-knot flying boats (with rare exceptions). With a well-planned build—say, ten Level 6 cannons—you can still reach a comfortable 80–130 knots, depending on your hull choice.[/p][h3][b]Q: Why disable multiple respawn points and limit respawning to the Three Whales?[/b][/h3][p]A: By leaving only one respawn point at the Three Whales, we’ve raised the stakes for each life. Returning to your death spot now requires using a translocator—and possibly a powerbank to recharge it. We also disabled forced cargo drops on death so you can decide whether to return to the place of your demise or move on.[/p][h3][b]Q: What do you hope to achieve with these changes?[/b][/h3][p]A: We aim for a balance in which every player can build a ship tailored to their play style or a specific activity, weighing survivability, firepower, and speed. We also updated repair costs—previous resource requirements didn’t match gameplay realities, so most players repaired only hulls. Now that ship preservation is vital, lower repair costs will help.[/p][h3][b]Q: What data will you focus on after the update? Which feedback is most important?[/b][/h3][p]A: We’re closely monitoring event statistics, ship and weapon selections, and player feedback on energy and weapon balance. We want to know what challenges you face when rebuilding your ship, whether your generators are sufficient, and your thoughts on the new meta and weapon balance. Your insights will guide our future balance decisions.[/p][h3][b]Q: Will you continue to make balance tweaks going forward?[/b][/h3][p]A: We’ve already [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2695490#scrollTop=333.3333435058594"]released one balance patch[/url] and will continue to track the situation and apply further adjustments as needed.[/p]

notes.title: Update Storm Tuning (1.0.48.3630)
notes.content: [p][i]New ships and weapons, easier repairs, improved hull-part stats, and increased PvP rewards. Energy consumption has also risen, so we’ve added new wind turbines. Weapons are now significantly more powerful, and on-foot mode is available in every major location.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/e5071c6245be363726db1cb81997849c3face65b.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]New Ships and Weapons[/h1][p][/p][p]Added new vessels available for boarding:[/p][p]• Rank V: ST Octa Seiner[/p][p]Its deck is smaller and hull is weaker than its peers, but it generates 300 energy. In afterburner mode it boosts top speed by 35% instead of the standard 20%.[/p][p]• Rank IV: Bulldog Trawler, Whiteout Boat, Brynhild Motor Sailer[/p][p]• Rank III: Charisma Sailboat, Stripe Patrol Boat, Riviera Motorboat[/p][p]• Rank II: Glam Sailboat, Caspian Small Trawler, Ares Multipurpose Boat, Bass Torpedo Boat, Exodus Survey Vessel, Fishing Trawler[/p][p]• Rank I: Husky Launch, Nyneve Boat, Minnie Minesweeper, Pomor Tugboat, Tragula Trawler, Leiden Boat[/p][p]New Level VII weapons:[/p][p]• Minigun[/p][p]1% drop chance in the loot of the Dreadreaper found beyond the sector boundary. Additionally, the Dreadreaper now guarantees 1 000–20 000 Chemical Waste per drop.[/p][p]• Smoke Grenade Launcher[/p][p]1% drop chance in the loot of the enhanced Dead Scuttlefish Boat found behind the “Hunt for the ‘Scuttlefish’ (Group)” teleport.[/p][p][/p][h1]Economic & Resource Changes[/h1][p][/p][p]• Repair costs reduced dramatically[/p][p]Resource requirements for repairing gear and weapons have been cut by tens to hundreds of times. Most items now repair using Scrap Iron only.[/p][p]• Consumable cooldowns added[/p][p]All consumables now have a cooldown: 45 s (Nitro: 30 s).[/p][p]• PvP rewards increased[/p][p]All PvP events now grant roughly 3× more medalions, and the cap limits have been raised accordingly.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/22db47e819ad509613624d64ffc0956938fbcb24.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]• Re-balanced energy consumption[/p][p]Electricity can no longer power everything at once; you must now allocate it wisely between firepower, speed, and survivability. All weapons and equipment draw significantly more energy. The longer a weapon’s range, the higher its energy cost.[/p][p] [/p][p]• Removed the deck-pump limit[/p][p]Survivability now depends on how much energy and deck space you’re willing to invest in pumps.[/p][p] [/p][p]• Added wind turbines[/p][p]Wind turbines can be crafted at your base. This is a fast and efficient way to achieve a small but comfortable energy level.[/p][p] [/p][p]• Changed cargo loss mechanics after defeat[/p][p]When your ship sinks, the contents of your hold no longer drop as a crate into the sea, so you won’t have to return for lost cargo after respawning. Any active insurances are automatically converted into medalions.[/p][p] [/p][p]• New respawn location after sinking[/p][p]By default, you now respawn at Three Whales after your ship sinks (with exceptions for certain quests and PvP events). The Translocator still allows teleportation to any previously visited location.[/p][p] [/p][p]• Adjusted weapon parameters[/p][p]Shotguns, grenade launchers, and machine guns have been substantially buffed to keep pace with cannons and rockets. tags.balance_change: • Repair costs reduced dramatically
Resource requirements for repairing gear and weapons have been cut by tens to hundreds of times. Most items now repair using Scrap Iron only.
• Consumable cooldowns added
All consumables now have a cooldown: 45 s (Nitro: 30 s).
• PvP rewards increased
All PvP events now grant roughly 3× more medalions, and the cap limits have been raised accordingly.
• Re-balanced energy consumption

Electricity can no longer power everything at once; you must now allocate it wisely between firepower, speed, and survivability. All weapons and equipment draw significantly more energy. The longer a weapon’s range, the higher its energy cost.
• Removed the deck-pump limit
Survivability now depends on how much energy and deck space you’re willing to invest in pumps.

tags.feature: • Added wind turbines
Wind turbines can be crafted at your base. This is a fast and efficient way to achieve a small but comfortable energy level.

tags.balance_change: • Changed cargo loss mechanics after defeat

When your ship sinks, the contents of your hold no longer drop as a crate into the sea, so you won’t have to return for lost cargo after respawning. Any active insurances are automatically converted into medalions.

tags.feature: • New respawn location after sinking
By default, you now respawn at Three Whales after your ship sinks (with exceptions for certain quests and PvP events). The Translocator still allows teleportation to any previously visited location.

notes.title: Meet the Beyond the Waves update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/970f9211edaf1dfa07b3c6f0d76d7778e2d3cce4.jpg[/img]
We’re proud to present the Beyond the Waves update featuring captivating storylines, powerful weapons and new challenges that are sure to please even the most seasoned captains.
The update introduces an entirely new team-based PvP mode, Control Points, where players must work together to capture and defend strategically important locations scattered across the waters. For those seeking even greater challenges, the game now features five dangerous zones, each guarded by formidable bosses of varying difficulty levels. Additionally, exciting stories await you in a new quest line. Your team will also gain a new crew member.

In this episode, we invite you to face off against a world boss lurking beyond the sector's edge. This unique new enemy will test your combat skills and strategies, delivering an epic battle unlike anything you've seen before in Age of Water.
To help you deal with the enemies more effectively, you can unlock a sixth tier of weapons with devastating firepower, including rocket launchers!

The world of Age of Water has become even more diverse with the addition of ten new land-based combat areas. Your crew will engage in intense close-quarters combat, while you'll need to adapt to new conditions and employ previously unseen tactics.

[h3]Full list of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new group PvP mode "Treasure Rush".
[*] Added five new boss locations with increasing difficulty.
[*] Added a unique world super boss outside the sector.
[*] Added 10 locations for a new type of missions — ground combat.
[*] Added the ability to obtain 6th rank weapons.
[*] Added a new type of weapon — rocket launcher.
[*] Added a new quest line that will unlock upon completing all base quests, The Battle for Three Whales, as well as the Tirpitz and Aircraft Carrier quest chains.
[*] Added a new crew member.
[*] Added Chinese and Russian voiceovers.
[*] Added new paints that can be earned as rewards for completing ground combat zones.
[*] Added support for Steam Game Recording feature.
[*] Added highlighting for chat messages.
[*] Improved the effect of ship disappearance at range.
[*] Improved AI behavior.
[*] Improved buoy and docked player boat behavior.
[*] The map always opens centered, even if many areas outside the sector are open.
[*] Changed the balance of hull armor.
[*] Changed the balance of fiber acquisition.
[*] Reduced excessive drop of small bait, adjusted fishing reward balance.
[*] Fixed a bug where loot from large fish could be missing.
[*] Modules in the preview are no longer painted.
[*] Fixed a bug causing prolonged freezes on PlayStation 5.
[*] Fixed bugs in displaying the player blacklist on Xbox.
[*] Fixed bugs that caused voice chat to disconnect.
[*] Fixed logical errors that led to progress blockage in quests "Recruitment", "A Geographical Hypothesis" and "Murderous Balloon".
[*] Fixed a bug where a quest object could appear inside the "Three Whales" location.
[*] Fixed a bug where no corks were awarded in the quest "Under Pressure".
[*] Fixed a bug where opponents without segments and large modules received too little damage from explosions.
[*] Fixed an issue with the disappearance of some modules installed on the "Merchant" cabin.
[*] Fixed a bug where a building could be available for construction at the base only after some time.
[*] Fixed a bug where the scanner might not react to mining zones.
[*] Fixed a bug where shooting sounds would disappear when firing from different weapons simultaneously.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing teleportation inside textures in the "Aircraft Carrier" location.
[*] Fixed a sorting issue when first opening the inventory with the "On Deck First" option selected.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented exiting the main menu of the game.
[*] Fixed bugs in displaying some character names in dialogues.
[*] Corrected mixed-up names for metal and wooden signboards.
[*] Fixed the ship window at a resolution of 5760x1080.
[*] Multiple technical fixes and optimizations.
[*] Corrections to bugs in dialogues and texts.
[/list]

Soon after the Beyond the Waves launches, we will conclude the Early Access phase and officially release the final version of Age of Water.

notes.title: Update “Against the Tide”
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ba3xXx7klYI;full][/previewyoutube]

The major update will bring numerous improvements, including: a new quest line and ships, instant building construction, enhanced weapons, a drone for automatic loot collection, improved speed balance, and much more. 

[h3]The full list of changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Continuation of the Silver Fleet questline, concluding the main story of the current game season.
[*] Antagonist questline featuring battles against four new bosses.
[*] Quests to recruit two new crew members.
[*] The shipwright now has three new unique ships. They can be obtained by completing his quests.
[*] Crafting items and building structures no longer require time. Ship module and weapon repair time has been significantly reduced. Dismantling buildings at the base returns 90% of the resources.
[*] New enhanced weapons: "reinforced" for ranks 2 and 3 and "shark" for ranks 4 and 5. Enhanced weapons require fragments, which are obtained through fishing, treasure hunting, shark hunting, among shipwrecks of Armadas and some other ships. Crafted at the base.
[*] New Armadas for playing at maximum difficulty. Lots of experience, medallions, and resources for crafting enhanced weapons. Also, new ships of ranks 3, 4, and 5 for boarding.
[*] Increased experience gained when sinking large ships. Added cork drops.
[*] Repeatable PVP/PVE quests for late game stages.
[*] Drone for automatic loot collection. Built at the base.
[*] New modules, including rare and themed ones. Obtained from enemies.
[*] New paints available in the base store.
[*] Improved balance of the power supply system. Changed parameters of batteries, generators, boost, and some skills.
[*] Improved speed balance. Changed parameters of some engines and hulls. Returned capacities, energy consumption during boost, etc. Improved stability during turns.
[*] Increased efficiency of high-rank pumps.
[*] Many deck superstructures now have modifiers for the equipment installed onto them. 
[*] The Armada spawn points and fishing locations are now shown on the map. 
[*] Now when crafting items and resources at your base, you can choose the quantity beforehand.
[*] Armor modules now cover the hull better.
[*] Sailor Lin will be able to wear a wig.
[*] Fishing rods now have different ranks and are available for crafting at the base.
[*] The ship’s rank is now visible in the Ship Menu.
[*] Fixed various map, inventory and item display bugs.
[*] Improved stability of engine sounds.
[*] Fixed problems with calculating some achievements.
[*] Fixed the battering ram damage. 
[*] Fixed problems with the battle at Camel Rock.
[*] Time for changing the flag for PvP has been reduced to 15 minutes.
[*] Time for boarding a defeated ship has been increased to 20 minutes. The hold of your previous ship now becomes a player’s "Lost Cargo" chest and won’t be lost. 
[*] Minefields with a lot of explosives now appear more frequently. Increased the number of resources acquired from broken and deactivated mines.
[*] Improved anchored ship stability.
[*] Added an arrow showing the exact direction of the whirlpool teleport. 
[*] Many corrections in the models of characters, interiors, islands, etc.
[*] Fixed bugs in various quests.
[*] Fixed the "shaking" of NPC in dialogues.
[*] Added voicelines for some dialogues.
[*] Refined some texts and descriptions.
[*] Some UI improvements for game controllers.
[/list]
The episode "Against the Tide" concludes the storyline that began with the release of the base game in the spring of this year.

notes.title: Gifts for all players! And what we’re working on at the moment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/d277fed3515e141433e1e2dd4f502aa63f89069f.jpg[/img]

We on the Age of Water development team constantly strive to improve the game, paying special attention to fixing errors based on your feedback. Thank you very much for your numerous messages, which have helped us identify many errors and balance issues.

[h2]All players who log into the game until June 14th 0:00 GMT get gifts![/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/8ed1b4ae3cc88202cafc6a113eda5222698df98d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/aca08805b4fc2bf7b7782757e50f507217bfe0cc.png[/img][/url]
Veteran Earl Access's Bandana

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/f08aef50f88d759b5cbf98f5a7d6c8a5ad5de7c3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/4c20ed95ed072e406b8f97a1a820fb8fc592b65c.png[/img][/url]
Veteran Earl Access's Colours

You can find the paint and the bandanna in the hold of your ship. 

We carefully analyze statistics and feedback to create an engaging game that meets your expectations, and we are now ready to share with you our plans for further improving Age of Water and news about fixes that have been implemented recently.
[h2]Battle Mechanics and Weapon Balance[/h2]
Many players prefer using cannons in the game, so we've decided to slightly reduce their stats for the sake of balance. We want other weapons in the game to be in demand as well. For example, we believe that machine guns should become more effective, as well as grenade launchers and shotguns. Additionally, we plan to rework the energy consumption of weapons in the game.
In the latest updates, we have already reduced the recoil that hulls received from enemy hits. However, their scope still shakes when the player is hit: many have complained about the inconvenience caused by it, and we plan to balance this aspect in the game.
[h2]More Convenient Map Navigation[/h2]
The current map navigation system does not always provide convenient orientation, although we have worked on improving it in recent updates, especially for gamepads. Nevertheless, we have decided to make additional changes.
We want players to find necessary resources or locations more easily, so we need to make the map more readable and informative. We will add various icons for different resources and objects (e.g., mines or loot on the water surface) to provide a clearer and more diverse display of various game elements on the map.
[h2]Events and Battles[/h2]
We continue to monitor cases where enemies may not spawn or quest items may be missing in specified locations. We will keep fixing these types of errors.
There are several variations of top-tier "battles" in the game. We want to make them more diverse and interesting: add more challenging opponents, slightly increase the duration of such battles to make playing both solo and in a squad more enjoyable.
We will also add the option to disable notifications about the start of PvP events to prevent these messages from distracting players from completing tasks.
[h2]Economy and Loot[/h2]
We have already rebalanced the cost of some buildings in the base and will continue to work in this direction. It may be necessary to reduce the amount of resources required for construction. We also plan to change the cost of crafting at the base, but this will require further analysis of how these changes will impact the economy.
Currently, there is an imbalance in obtaining medallions in PvP missions like "Convoy" and "Mangrove Pearl”. Therefore, we are reviewing the reward system to ensure balance.
By the way, we have increased the loot pickup radius for top rank ships to simplify the resource collection for more experienced players who need much more loot than beginners.
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We are making efforts to fix bugs that occur in the game. Some players report that sometimes the item crafting process can get stuck, and after restarting the game, the item remains uncrafted, but resources are still spent. Over the past few updates, we have fixed similar issues, so if you are still facing such problems, please let us know and provide as much information as possible.

Thank you for your interest in Age of Water! We sincerely thank you for actively participating in the life of the game and for your feedback, which helps it evolve further. Keep sharing bug reports, impressions, and suggestions with us — and we will continue to work on making the game better. Happy sailing!

notes.title: Let’s talk about work done
notes.content:
Captains, during the last 2 weeks we’ve released 5 updates for Age of Water, where we’ve paid special attention to fixes and improvements based on your feedback from Steam, social networks, and in-game messages. Thank you for your active participation in Age of Water! 

[h1]Resetting crew skills[/h1]
As players were progressing through Age of Water, they were researching new weapon types and unlocking crew skills. And with each next level, the desire to change the choice they made earlier for each character was likely to grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/d7a6d25eff9c95d88f1de0b73f97a3e377ba732b.jpg[/img]

So we’ve added an option for this. You need a Smith’s Neutralizer that can me bought in the store at the base. How does it work? After buying it, go to the “Crew” tab, choose a character and press the “Reset” button, then reassign skill points as you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/74a8380b4225217040b608feb5b6258aeb2b58d9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mass Disassembly[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/1e7ba705d696220d06b531fd1559a66dae2f3401.jpg[/img]

How much time have you spent in the sea, disassembling weak armor and low level machine guns that have outlived their usefulness and were just eating up space in your hull? We’ve seen your messages about how tedious it is to go through each item separately. Now you can highlight several items at once to send them to the disassembly queue and get resources.

[h1]Boarding ships [/h1]
Imagine how sad it is to forget your belongings in the hull of your previous ship as you switch to a new one after boarding it! We’ve seen several messages from players who lost all their items, having forgotten to put them onto their new ship.
Now after capturing a ship, all your items will be carefully put in a drifting chest that you’ll be able to collect.

[h1]Lost cargo[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/540ca1101f377c3ae4e6718742bc9a9fd056294b.jpg[/img]

Here are some more improvements related to the sinking of your ship:
[list]
[*]now all post offices are respawn points: this way you’ll be able to reach the place where your ship was sunk faster and reclaim lost cargo;
[*]lost cargo chest can be bought for corks from one of the traders at the Three Whales or on the Tirpitz;[/list]
[h1]Share your loot with friends[/h1]
One of the most popular requests from players that has received the highest priority from the developers is a system for sharing experience and loot after a battle. Sometimes you kept attacking an enemy just to see some passer-by finish them off and receive all the experience and loot.
Justice has been served! Part of experience, medallions, and loot for sunk enemies can now be received by the players who damaged them. And we’ll keep improving rewards for team play.
We’ve also adjusted battle scenario delays! It means that enemy spawns have been slowed down and now feel more organic. And there will be less cases where enemies spawn in the same place after a battle.
Let’s list other fixes that are meant to make leveling up and crafting easier:
[list]
[*]the amount of resources gained from excavations and defeating enemies has been increased to make progress more comfortable;
[*]the number of mining points in locations where you can farm resources has been increased;
[*]an error that caused the crafting progress on the player’s base to continue while displaying as being canceled in the IU has been fixed;
[*]crafting on the base now correctly continues even if the player is offline. [/list]
We also try to make the gameplay as comfortable as possible, so we’ve replaced emojis with more useful ones and added an option to disable music on the base. After all, constantly listening to an out of tune guitar can ruin the mood and distract from serious tasks :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/37d492823cc01125c9d6a99f866255fac367f069.jpg[/img]

We’d like to thank all of our active players who send bug reports, helping us to find problems in the game. We carefully consider each one of your messages and do everything we can to make the game more stable and enjoyable for you.
Soon we’ll tell you what other improvements and fixes the developers are working on right now!
